data.name: Nirmit
data.gender_notes: Nirmit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nirmit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir-mit,' which means 'not-sent' or 'self-manifested.' In Hindu mythology, Nirmit is a name for the divine architect, Vishwakarma, who created the universe. It is a name for one who creates or makes things, a craftsman, an artist, or a builder. The name Nirmit carries the meaning “Creator, Maker, Craftsman” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nirmit usually hope their child will grow to embody creator, maker, craftsman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of creation and craftsmanship.
data.etymology: Nirmit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Creator, Maker, Craftsman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nirmit total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
